output.methodChoice: Collected two items: X7 (rejects split by press, resin, shift and operator group), then X1 (dryer outlet and feed-throat moisture, plus the same-lot dryer swap). Stopped at 2 of 2.
output.brief:
Cause: one combination, Arnholt resin dried in Press 5's dryer (D5). Neither Arnholt nor D5 alone raises rejects, and the new operators are not the cause. Maintenance is half right: D5 caused nothing until wetter Arnholt arrived, but it is not fine.

Evidence: Press 5 on Arnholt rejects 9.9%; Press 5 on Quillan 0.9%; Press 7 on either resin 0.7–0.8%. Within that bad group, shifts match and new hires match experienced operators (9.9% vs 10.3%). Second shift looks worse only because all its VX runs on Press 5. D5 is barely drying: Arnholt leaves it at 0.25–0.31% moisture against a 0.20% limit. Decisive test: one Arnholt lot gave 10.4% rejects through D5 and 0.8% through a −40 °C portable dryer on the same press.

Do now: no improvement plans; keep Arnholt but off D5 (second shift: Quillan on Press 5, or the portable dryer). Repair D5, verify −40 °C, then restore the alarm limit. Check press-side moisture on every lot. Don't rent space to move Arnholt yet: it has only been stored in the annex, so that effect is unproven.

Confidence: high on cause and fix; low on why Arnholt arrives wetter.
